name: simplex
description: Run each Claude Code session from its own SimpleX group: prompt it, approve its actions and tool use, and get its answers in the SimpleX app.

main_group.title: Main group
main_group.description: Name of the SimpleX group where you join the groups of your sessions.

approve.title: Approval
approve.description: requests: you approve connections and messages in the SimpleX app. host: Claude Code asks you instead, after an owner approves this in the session's group.

expire_hours.title: Expiry in hours
expire_hours.description: Actions you have not approved expire after this many hours.

approve_guest_files.title: Approve Claude's files for guests
approve_guest_files.description: On: while a session's group has a guest, a member from the Main group approves each file Claude sends there. Off: Claude's files reach guests at once.
